paragraphs.plain: To enhance students' capabilities to craft-making and enrich their extracurricular life, the craft-making activities will be held on the playground at 4 p.m. this Friday. I'm glad you are interested in the craft demonstrate and willing to give a hand.

marks.note: capability 后接 to do 或 of doing；craft-making 是动名词，应为 capabilities in craft-making。
词性错：demonstrate 是动词，此处需名词 → the craft demonstration 或 the crafts on display。

paragraphs.plain: The craftmen will show paper-cutting and bamboo weaving Of course, there are other activities on the playground. Let me keep a little secret for you.

marks.note: 拼写错 → craftsmen。真题邮件里 Paul 用的就是 craftsmen，抄题干就能对！
具体、加分，符合“介绍内容”要求。

marks.text: Let me keep a little secret for you
marks.note: 俏皮，但风险高。考试应用文要信息完整、表达得体；“卖关子”显得不专业，且浪费词数（只有 100 词）。建议换成实质内容。

paragraphs.plain: You are willing to give a hand. We are so grateful. Can you help prepare seats and test audio equipment? We will gather the school hall at 2 p.m. this Friday.

marks.text: You are willing to give a hand. We are so grateful.
marks.note: 逻辑略松 + 时态不当。这是对 Paul 的“陈述”，像在复述他的话（第 1 段已说过一次 willing to give a hand），与题干 Please let me know what I can do 的衔接不够直接。可直接给出任务，并补一句衔接。

marks.text: Can you help prepare seats and test audio equipment?
marks.note: 📌 任务具体（摆座位 + 试音响），符合“请对方帮忙”要求。建议套《万能模板》8.6 书信语料 ^tmpl-letter-appreciate 的礼貌软化句式：Would you be able to assist with ___? / I would appreciate it if you could ___.
📌 标准结尾句式，全对。模板库 8.6 也推荐 I look forward to hearing from you.
标点错：书信格式应为 Yours sincerely,（中间无逗号，末尾逗号）。
